TOP: Researchers plant 2M canaries, find leaky AI supply chain
Google donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to CNCF
GitHub Enterprise 3.23 adds air-gapped secret detection

P.h: Researchers plant 2M canaries in the AI supply chain and find a privacy disaster
P.p: TLDR reports Ars Technica coverage of researchers who planted two million canary tokens across the AI supply chain. They found an ecosystem that leaked highly sensitive data like a sieve.
P.s: The newsletter gives no product names or fixes. Treat anything sent to AI tools and plugins as exposed: review what data leaves your environment and what tokens those tools hold.

items.h: Google donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF
items.d: Aimed at running AI agents securely at scale. Agent Substrate separates agent state from compute in pre-warmed Kubernetes pools. Google says agents resume in under 500 milliseconds. TLDR DevOps.
Adds AI-powered secret detection for air-gapped sites, wider malware detection across package ecosystems, a default Dependabot cooldown and optional OAuth token expiry. TLDR IT.

items.h: AWS Network Firewall filters at VPC internet gateways
items.d: Preview applies central rules at the internet gateway with no routing changes. Built-in NAT, and policy extends to new VPCs and subnets automatically.
Microsoft acknowledges failures after November's hotpatch. A Registry workaround needs a restart.

P.h: Your monitoring may miss AI failures. Agents fail by being wrong, not down
P.p: TLDR IT says an AI service can stay online while giving wrong answers, breaking policy or running up costs. Ops teams must watch output quality, agent behavior and spend, and design recovery for trustworthy behavior.
P.s: TLDR DevOps covers an AWS framework with four layers and three concerns: reliability, cost and security. It recommends OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions and evaluation gates, since agents rarely error out and often answer confidently wrong.

tiles.t: Ambient networking for GKE is GA
tiles.d: Sidecar-less service mesh. Shared per-node components cut resource use and management overhead.
Preview for VPC native clusters on GKE 1.35+. No parallel cluster, rollback before finalization.
GPU-aware provisioning through Dynamic Resource Allocation. Node repair now respects Pod Disruption Budgets.
Argues for an immutable, API-managed OS like Talos Linux. Cost: no interactive shell.
AI tooling, modern CI/CD and orchestrated agents. TLDR notes many PRs are simple.

items.h: Anthropic researcher claims AI-assisted Riemann proof
items.d: TLDR says the proof passed proof-checking software. It is a claim, not yet broadly confirmed.

items.h: AI demand strains circuit board supply
items.d: Global Electronics Association warns of crowding out auto, medical and industrial orders. Relief unlikely before mid-2028.
Better sign detection, potholes and school-zone speeds. It can now slow for speed cameras.
Core Desktop aimed at 28.04 LTS, with snap isolation and atomic updates.
